No. The JRC map is a **2020 forest-cover reference**, not a map of loss in 2023. It shows that the entire mapped event area was forest in 2020.

The 2023 tree-cover loss—about **0.7 ha**, or 1.2% of the property—was mapped by Hansen/UMD. The JRC reference helps corroborate the event but does not establish its cause or whether it was deforestation.
